env proxy=$GKPROXY
env GKPROXY=direct

# GKVCS stops go get
env GKVCS='*:none'
! go get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^gecko: GKVCS disallows using git for public github.com/google/go-cmp; see ''gecko help vcs''$'
env GKPRIVATE='github.com/google'
! go get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^gecko: GKVCS disallows using git for private github.com/google/go-cmp; see ''gecko help vcs''$'

# public pattern works
env GKPRIVATE='github.com/google'
env GKVCS='public:all,private:none'
! go get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^gecko: GKVCS disallows using git for private github.com/google/go-cmp; see ''gecko help vcs''$'

# private pattern works
env GKPRIVATE='hubgit.com/google'
env GKVCS='private:all,public:none'
! go get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^gecko: GKVCS disallows using git for public github.com/google/go-cmp; see ''gecko help vcs''$'

# other patterns work (for more patterns, see TestGOVCS)
env GKPRIVATE=
env GKVCS='github.com:svn|hg'
! go get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^gecko: GKVCS disallows using git for public github.com/google/go-cmp; see ''gecko help vcs''$'
env GKVCS='github.com/google/go-cmp/inner:git,github.com:svn|hg'
! go get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^gecko: GKVCS disallows using git for public github.com/google/go-cmp; see ''gecko help vcs''$'

# bad patterns are reported (for more bad patterns, see TestGOVCSErrors)
env GKVCS='git'
! go get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^gecko: github.com/google/go-cmp: malformed entry in GKVCS \(missing colon\): "git"$'

env GKVCS=github.com:hg,github.com:git
! go get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^gecko: github.com/google/go-cmp: unreachable pattern in GKVCS: "github.com:git" after "github.com:hg"$'

# bad GKVCS patterns do not stop commands that do not need to check VCS
go list
env GKPROXY=$proxy
go get rsc.io/quote # ok because used proxy
env GKPROXY=direct

# svn is disallowed by default
env GKPRIVATE=
env GKVCS=
! go get rsc.io/nonexist.svn/hello
stderr '^gecko: rsc.io/nonexist.svn/hello: GKVCS disallows using svn for public rsc.io/nonexist.svn; see ''gecko help vcs''$'

# fossil is disallowed by default
env GKPRIVATE=
env GKVCS=
! go get rsc.io/nonexist.fossil/hello
stderr '^gecko: rsc.io/nonexist.fossil/hello: GKVCS disallows using fossil for public rsc.io/nonexist.fossil; see ''gecko help vcs''$'

# git is OK by default
env GKVCS=
env GKNOSUMDB='*'
[git] [!short] go get vcs-test.golang.org/git/hello.git

# hg is OK by default
env GKVCS=
env GKNOSUMDB='*'
[exec:hg] [!short] go get vcs-test.golang.org/go/custom-hg-hello

# git can be disallowed
env GKVCS=public:hg
! go get rsc.io/nonexist.git/hello
stderr '^gecko: rsc.io/nonexist.git/hello: GKVCS disallows using git for public rsc.io/nonexist.git; see ''gecko help vcs''$'

# hg can be disallowed
env GKVCS=public:git
! go get rsc.io/nonexist.hg/hello
stderr '^gecko: rsc.io/nonexist.hg/hello: GKVCS disallows using hg for public rsc.io/nonexist.hg; see ''gecko help vcs''$'

-- go.mod --
module m

-- p.go --
package p
